tagline: Home Assistant switches on your wall, token stays on the device
description: Up to eight Home Assistant switches or lights as big tiles. The device reads each entity's state straight from your Home Assistant on the LAN and toggles it with one tap; the long-lived token is stored on the device and only ever sent to the Home Assistant URL you set. An 'All off' tile turns everything off. Optionally reads all states in a single /api/template request.

changelog.notes: First release: 2×4 tile grid, toggle with optimistic update, All off, single-request mode, landscape layout.
